messages:
Jordan Kim: Hi team, onboarding day 2. I can list contexts but `kubectl get ns` returns Forbidden. Current context is `redwood-dev/jordan`. I need to run a sample microservice and port-forward. Who should I ask for RBAC and what's the recommended namespace name?

Sam (infra): Welcome Jordan! For onboarding we create `onboard-<name>` namespaces. Do you need to deploy manifests or just port-forward? I can grant a temporary `edit` role via a serviceaccount for 12-24h.

Jordan Kim: Deploying a small helm chart and port-forwarding to test integration, so `edit` would be ideal for the day. Also my kubeconfig shows two user entries, how do I know which maps to the SA?

Priya - DevEx: We usually keep the same context name. Infra will bind the serviceaccount to your username via a RoleBinding; you don't need to edit kubeconfig. Sam will create `onboard-jordan` and attach `sa/jordan-onboard`. After that do `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=onboard-jordan`.

Sam (infra): Created ns `onboard-jordan`, svcaccount `jordan-onboard`, RoleBinding to `edit` for 24h. Try: `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev/jordan && kubectl auth can-i create deployments -n onboard-jordan && kubectl get pods -n onboard-jordan`. If anything returns no, paste the output.

Jordan Kim: Thanks — `kubectl auth can-i create deployments` returns yes, `kubectl get pods -n onboard-jordan` lists nothing (expected). Deploying chart now.

Elena (eng): For port-forwarding after your service is up run `kubectl port-forward svc/my-app 8080:80 -n onboard-jordan`. If you see "connection refused" check service selector labels and `kubectl get endpoints -n onboard-jordan`.

Jordan Kim: Port-forward worked. One tiny ask: how do I make kubectl default to the namespace so I don't type -n?

Priya - DevEx: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=onboard-jordan` — that'll stick for the context. Also add `alias k=kubectl` in your shell rc to save keystrokes. We have a short onboarding doc with these tips, ping me and I'll send link.

access-bot: Temporary rolebinding created for Jordan Kim (jordan-onboard) in namespace onboard-jordan. Expires in 24h. If you need extension open infra-support ticket with team lead approval.

Jordan Kim: All set, thanks everyone! Will file a ticket if we need more time. :tada:
